trigger: If wraith_alive and NOT wraith_injured and trust.wraith>=5: trail lost in the whiteout; Wraith leads.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The trail's gone. The creek's gone. Everything is white, every direction, and the light is failing.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Nose up. Into the wind. A long sniff. Then she pulls. Hard. Left, uphill, away from where you'd have gone.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Sulfur. Faint. Then stronger. Rotten eggs never smelled so good. Steam. Galena.

nodes.speaker: braith
nodes.text: Good girl. Good girl. Best girl in the whole Air Force.
